description: Create an isolated git worktree at .worktrees/<name> under the effective root, on a new branch wt/<name> from the current HEAD. Used to give a sub-agent its own working copy so parallel edits never collide; the effective root must be inside a git work tree. Returns the worktree's canonical path and branch.

name.description: Worktree name — letters, digits, `-` and `_` only. The worktree is created at `.worktrees/<name>` under the effective root, on a new branch `wt/<name>` from the current HEAD.

branch.description: The branch the worktree is on (`wt/<name>`), from the root's HEAD.

path.description: Canonical absolute path of the new worktree.
